author: Lost LeBlanc
description:
We’re crossing Africa coast to coast on motorbikes. In the mountains of Lesotho, a single trail trapped Cam and me in a valley for two days. It took a borrowed phone, a six-hour rescue drive and half a village to get us out.

This is Episode 17 of Lost Way Round Africa - our mission to cross the African continent coast to coast and experience everything that happens along the way.
